title: Universal Protocol v1 — Message Envelope
description: Every Universal Protocol message is wrapped in this envelope. Versioned, request-correlated, timestamped.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol major version. Clients and nodes negotiate this during pairing/handshake.

requestId.description: Correlates a response or event with the request that caused it. Client-generated for requests; echoed by the node.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Node clock is authoritative for event ordering.

eventId.description: Monotonic per-node event sequence. Present on events only. Basis of missed-event replay.

payload.description: Typed payload. Schema selected by (type, payload.kind). See *.schema.json.

trace.description: Optional debugging/diagnostics correlation. Secrets are never included.
